openings.claim: Keep surname dividers; make behind-desk exceptions live, recording household-name discrepancies and correcting locations whenever books move.
openings.discriminator: Verified mappings and current locations reduce second searches versus delays persisting mainly during the arrival burst, favoring congestion.
openings.probe: Clerk records address correctness, second searches, queues and timing; cap preparation at ten minutes and count reconciliation separately. Verify claimant-to-hold identity before handoff.
openings.uncertainty: Household mismatches causing second searches, feasible service-time updates and an adequate verification procedure remain unproven; continued searches despite correct records defeat the explanation.

openings.claim: Existing-cart arrivals may outperform alphabetic shelving; the ten fast pickups challenge universal shelving superiority.
openings.discriminator: Comparable cohorts retain a cart advantage versus the advantage disappearing with volume or book size.
openings.probe: Observe natural cart and shelf pickups using existing timing paper; record volume, size and correctness, with preparation capped at ten minutes. Unmatched comparisons are inconclusive.
openings.uncertainty: Comparable cohorts, cart capacity and routine retention benefits are unknown; slower retrieval, correctness loss or capacity failure defeat retention.

openings.claim: Link divider zones to slip sections: check exceptions first, otherwise search the narrowed shelf region; pencil-correct moves.
openings.discriminator: Matched links outperform equally current flat-slip combinations and scrambled links; freshness alone predicts no link advantage.
openings.probe: Rehearse four paper arrangements with identical sequences, including cart arrivals and household mismatches; measure routing time/errors within ten total preparation-plus-rehearsal minutes.
openings.uncertainty: Informative comparisons, current records, identity verification and daily maintenance feasibility are unconfirmed; household mismatches remain unresolved. Incomplete comparisons establish no benefit.

decision: Run bounded probes only: sole existing clerk, identities behind desk, two existing shelves/one cart, ten daily preparation clerk-minutes. Fit covers probes; 95% within two minutes and zero wrong-reader handoffs remain unproven. All evidence is synthetic; interview representativeness is unknown.
